________________________________
From: Thomas, Christopher <cdthomas@freepress.com>
Sent: Thursday, December 19, 2019 12:31 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>; Crawford, Kirkland <kcrawford@freepress.com>
Subject: Letter to staff
All: I wanted to make everyone aware of a few staff changes for 2020.

First: Vince Ellis has accepted a voluntary buyout and will leave the Free Press in February. This was a decision Vince had been thinking about for a while, and if you read the report in Crains about Freep staff changes, you know it’s a decision he’s at peace with. Vince owned the Pistons beat for us for a decade, and I’ll miss watching him crush the folks upstairs literally every single day. Please wish Vince well. He was gracious enough to stay through the NBA trade deadline. His last day is Feb. 17.

Second: Vince’s departure allows us to think outside the box with how we fill the position. And so we’re sliding Anthony Fenech over to Pistons/enterprise from the Tigers beat. He will step in and begin turning the screws on the Pistons after Vince’s last day, and he’ll also begin pursuing the type of heavy-hitting enterprise that satisfies his journalistic soul. Anthony has long said he wanted to broaden his reporting scope at the Free Press, and we agreed this move could put him on the path to doing that. Which means you’ll see Anthony still pursuing untold stories on the Tigers, the Pistons, or any other beat if there’s a good enough story. Anthony and I already are brainstorming names for a Tigers beat writer. If anyone comes to mind, please let one of us know.

Chris Thomas
Sports editor, Detroit Free Press
Great Lakes regional sports director, USA TODAY Network
